title: Screen Mapping
description: Canonical metadata linking a screens/ directory to its wireframe, TSX implementation, and route.

wireframe_path.description: Path to the canonical XML wireframe (relative to repo root).

local_wireframe_path.description: Local copy of the wireframe inside the screens/ directory.

source_component_path.description: Path to the current live production component that implements this screen.

screen_component_path.description: Path to the TSX file paired directly inside screens/ (comparison reference).

route.description: The production URL path this screen maps to (must exist in ROUTE_REGISTRY).

migration_status.description: Current migration state of this screen.

notes.description: Free-text notes about this screen's mapping.
